name: Random Effect
description: Its outcome is chosen from a table — by die roll, by deliberate choice among named options, or both — rather than being one fixed effect.

mechanics.text: On activation, consult this Effect's own table. Where the individual entries are worth naming, this record's own featureParams.options carries them as a real list ([{name, text}, ...]) — the exact same per-record options shape Crucible's own Multiattack already uses for its own attack-reference list (crucible/js/app.js's multiattackOptionGroups), reused here rather than reinvented: a shared Feature can't hold 27 different items' own option lists on itself, so the list lives in featureParams like every other per-record number this Feature system tracks. featureParams.optionCount is the fallback/residual count — either the whole table when naming every entry isn't worth the effort (a large flavor-heavy d100 table), or the count of entries left over once the genuinely feature-worthy ones have their own real Features assigned alongside this one (see Robe of Useful Items, which pairs this with feat.summoned-object for its own named patches and keeps optionCount only for its own '4d4 other patches').
